major_cooldowns.name: Avatar
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown, with or just before Colossus Smash, since Anger Management shortens both and keeps the two windows paired.

major_cooldowns.name: Ravager
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop it just before Colossus Smash, inside the last 2 seconds of that cooldown, since it gets no cooldown reduction of its own and its Cleave buff only pays off overlapped with Crushing Combo.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Guide links Ravager as both 152277 and 228920; 152277 is a retired id with no Wowhead page (nether.wowhead.com/tooltip/spell/152277 returns not-found) and never appears in sampled Arms Casts tables. 228920 is the live Ravager spell, confirmed by Wowhead tooltip (90 s base cooldown, 1 charge) and WCL gameData ability lookup.

major_cooldowns.name: Colossus Smash
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Your one burst window: press it strictly on cooldown, track the real timer rather than the 45 second tooltip because Anger Management cuts it hard, and fill every global inside the 10 second debuff.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 167105 is the cast id; 208086 is the matching aura used by the rules.

major_cooldowns.name: Bladestorm
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it on cooldown or timed onto an add pack, entering it early in Colossus Smash so its triggered effects overlap the debuff; the three-stack Imminent Demise glow is not a use indicator.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Guide links Bladestorm as 227847; 446035 is the cast id observed in the sampled parse and is the one used here.

major_cooldowns.name: Demolish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it inside Colossus Smash rather than on cooldown, ideally at 10 stacks of Colossal Might with more than 2 seconds of debuff left, and use the channel to eat a stun or knockback since off-GCD buttons still work through it.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Colossus hero talent; name-verified castable, not pressed in the sampled Slayer parse.

major_cooldowns.name: Sweeping Strikes
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: On two or more targets, refresh it whenever it is down and Colossus Smash is more than 10 seconds away, so its 12 cleaved abilities are not wasted outside the burst window.

major_cooldowns.name: Wrecking Throw
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Ranged filler while you are out of melee, and your second priority behind Colossus Smash against anything with an absorb shield, where the 500% bonus makes it the biggest single hit in the kit.

major_cooldowns.name: Light's Potential
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drink it with more than 8 seconds left on the Colossus Smash debuff, or in the last 25 seconds of the fight.

defensives.name: Die by the Sword
defensives.usage_rule: Your primary survivability button at 30% damage reduction and 100% parry; save it for direct physical damage, where it can carry you through a short tanking stint.

defensives.name: Spell Reflection
defensives.usage_rule: Raise it into a spell aimed at you to reflect it outright and take 20% less magic damage for 5 seconds; it can be pressed during a Demolish channel.

defensives.name: Rallying Cry
defensives.usage_rule: Treat it as a raid cooldown for a scripted damage event rather than a personal one, and pre-plan it since it costs a global.

defensives.name: Impending Victory
defensives.usage_rule: Cheap 30% max-health self-heal to top up between damage events instead of holding it.

defensives.name: Berserker Rage
defensives.usage_rule: Break and stay immune to Fear, Sap and some incapacitate effects for 6 seconds.

rules.description: Open Charge, Avatar, Rend, Colossus Smash, Mortal Strike
rules.action: Pull with Charge, then Avatar, then Rend for the bleed, then Colossus Smash, then Mortal Strike; slot Ravager just before Colossus Smash and Bladestorm or Demolish straight after it.

rules.description: Avatar with or just before Colossus Smash
rules.action: Press Avatar with or immediately before Colossus Smash; Anger Management pulls both cooldowns down together, so a solo Avatar means you drifted one of them.
Start Bladestorm early in the 10 second Colossus Smash window so the whole channel and every effect it triggers is amplified; only break that for a timed add pack.
Hold Demolish for Colossus Smash instead of pressing it on cooldown, at 10 stacks of Colossal Might with over 2 seconds of debuff remaining.

rules.description: Execute consumes every Sudden Death proc
rules.action: Cash every Sudden Death into Execute; it stacks to 2 so you have room to finish a Mortal Strike first, but never sit on it long enough to overcap.
Execute scales with the Rage it consumes, so fire it above 40 Rage outside Sudden Death and above 75 with Deep Wounds talented; a free Sudden Death Execute is always fine.
Once the target drops below 35%, switch to the Execute rotation: Execute is the filler and Slam should all but disappear, with only Heroic Strike and Mortal Strike still ahead of it.

rules.description: Cleave on three or more targets
rules.action: From 3 targets up, Cleave is the top button and stays on cooldown; it auto-casts Slam or Heroic Strike and feeds Reap the Storm and Colossal Might, so do not spend those globals on single-target fillers.

source_summary: Arms revolves around one frequent burst window: Colossus Smash goes out on cooldown, shortened well below its tooltip by Anger Management, with Avatar aligned to it and every available global crammed into the 10 second debuff. Slayer feeds Bladestorm into that window and cashes Sudden Death procs into Execute, while Colossus holds Demolish for Colossus Smash and drops Ravager just before it for the Crushing Combo overlap. Everything else is Rage discipline: keep Mortal Strike and, on 3 or more targets, Cleave on cooldown, and never spend so low that the next Mortal Strike is delayed.
